1.e4 d5 2.exd5 Qxd5 3.Nc3 Qa5 4.d4 e5 5..strategy: Defends the e5 pawn and develops, the most natural way to keep the extra material. The c3 knight stays pinned for now, so White has to complete development carefully while Black's pieces aim at it.

Pins the c3 knight again, now with the bishop while the queen supports it from behind, and threatens to take the knight and double White's pawns. Black keeps the initiative and builds pressure instead of rushing to win the pawn back.
